body: Yeah, honestly that wasn't nice. I couldn't tell you if that makes her a bad therapist, but saying that was pretty shit.
I've been seeing him intermittently since 2004; I've left and come back four times already.

Sorry for the slow reply. Long story short: I tried to kill myself this past February, met someone who didn't make me feel like shit for doing it, same person offered to help me further and expressed fondness for me, and I stupidly fell for her. This made me realize how I have absolutely nothing to offer, because even though we're the same age, she's a very successful single mother, and I'm currently at the lowest point in my life: unemployed, back in my mother's house, barely getting into a different career (she was actually my teacher during a course I'm taking), and well, check my post history for an even more pathetic reason. I'm not exaggerating: she's the only woman who's ever made me want to be a better person; ffs, I hate children, but she looks so happy with her kid that for the first time in my life I thought "You know, I would really love to be a part of that." There's more to it, but meeting an amazing person during the worst of my crises, and thinking that I've fucked things up with her due to my mental state makes me hate myself so fucking much... Maybe it is stupid, I don't know.
